name: Dokidoki Summer Lesson ~Kyoukasho wa Oshiete Kurenai~
original_name: どきどきサマーレッスン ～教科書は教えてくれないっ～
source:
It's summer break, our guy is bored. He decided to find work as a tutor, his way of meeting girls and get paid for it. His student turned out to be his neighbor's sister. What will he teach her? And will he go after one sister or both, you decide.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
暑假到了，百无聊赖的主人公决定找一份家教工作，既能赚钱，也有机会认识女孩。没想到，他的学生竟是邻居的妹妹。他究竟会教给她什么？又会选择其中一个姐妹，还是将两人一并追到手？一切由你决定。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
